procedures.title: Basic Source Check
procedures.description: Evaluate whether a claim is supported by an identified source within a narrowly stated scope.

steps.description: Identify the exact NOTHING subject and claim being evaluated.
Identify and record evidence appropriate to the claim.
Check whether the evidence supports the stated claim within the declared scope.
Record the result, limitations, evidence identifiers, procedure version and timestamp.

procedures.notes: This procedure does not establish legal status, financial condition, reputation, ownership beyond the tested scope, or universal trustworthiness.
